findings.title: IntoIter::drop double-frees elements when an element's Drop panics
findings.evidence: In `IntoIter::drop` -> `drop_non_singleton` (lines 2544-2550), the vector is moved into a local `vec` at line 2546, `ptr::drop_in_place(&mut vec[this.start..])` is called at line 2547, and the length is only reset by `vec.set_len_non_singleton(0)` at line 2548. If any element's `Drop::drop` panics, unwinding skips line 2548 and drops the local `vec` while its header still holds the original length. `ThinVec::drop` (lines 1915-1923) then calls `ptr::drop_in_place(&mut this[..])` and `dealloc(...)` on the now-empty `this.vec`, so every element is dropped and the buffer is freed a second time. This includes the range `[start..len)` already dropped by line 2547 and the prefix `[0..start)` already moved out by `IntoIter::next` (line ~2510). Reachable from safe code: `let mut it = v.into_iter(); let _ = it.next(); drop(it);` where a remaining element's Drop panics; e.g. `catch_unwind(|| drop(it))` then the process observes the double free. This is the exact issue fixed in thin-vec 0.2.16 (RELEASES.md: 'Fix two double-drop issues with ThinVec::clear() and ThinVec::into_iter() when the Drop implementation of the item panics') by wrapping line 2547 in a DropGuard. PoC: /tmp/pocdd PoC 2.

findings.title: ThinVec::clear double-frees elements when an element's Drop panics
findings.evidence: `ThinVec::clear` (lines 1082-1087) calls `ptr::drop_in_place(&mut self[..])` at line 1084 and only afterwards runs `self.set_len(0)` at line 1085. If any element's `Drop::drop` panics, unwinding skips line 1085 while the still-live vector retains its original length. When that vector is subsequently dropped, `ThinVec::drop` (lines 1915-1923) calls `ptr::drop_in_place(&mut this[..])` and `dealloc(...)`, dropping and freeing the already-dropped elements a second time (double free / use-after-free). Reachable from safe code without any unsafe block by the caller: build a vector whose element Drop can panic, call `v.clear()`, let the panic unwind (or catch it with `catch_unwind`), then drop `v`. This is the second issue fixed in thin-vec 0.2.16 (RELEASES.md) by wrapping line 1084 in a DropGuard that always runs `set_len(0)`. PoC: /tmp/pocdd PoC 1 and /tmp/pocfree.
